## About
Robotics engineer at Toborlife.ai. Helps design an end-to-end humanoid
pipeline (teleop data collection, VLA training, Jetson deploy) on
Unitree G1 and Go2 using NVIDIA Isaac GR00T N1.7, Cosmos Reason 2,
and Cosmos 3, with a focus on real-time latency and current
research / industry practice.
M.S. Computer Engineering, SJSU.
MoRAL paper presented at IEEE IMC 2026, Fukuoka.

## Skills
Physical AI: Isaac GR00T N1.7, Cosmos Reason 2, Cosmos 3, π0 (pi0),
Isaac Teleop, Gear Sonic.
Robots and edge: Unitree G1, Go2, Jetson Thor, Jetson AGX, ROS 2,
Isaac ROS, Isaac Sim.
Perception: LiDAR, BEV, NVIDIA Warp, PyTorch, LoRA.
